create_transforming_consumer: create a TransformingConsumer that applies a transformation function before passing values to a downstream consumer
build_iterable_consumer: build an IterableConsumer that buffers consumed values and yields them when iterated over in a thread-safe manner
use_threadswitching_consumer: use a ThreadSwitchingConsumer to serialize and asynchronously route values to a sink via a thread pool
test_iterable_consumer_iteration: test the IterableConsumer by consuming values in one thread and iterating over them in another
review_transforming_consumer_terminate: review the TransformingConsumer terminate method to ensure it properly propagates termination to the downstream consumer
